title: Isolate irrelevant inherited MCP servers for TORCH agents
description: Inherited global Vercel MCP authentication noise appeared in failed and successful Codex launches. Add project/session-scoped allowlist/isolation that retains TORCH identity-bound tools and does not rewrite or delete user-global harness settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests prove TORCH tools remain available while unrelated MCP startup is excluded
Global provider configuration and credentials are unchanged
Owner can inspect and change the project-scoped isolation policy
